summary: Innoviz Technologies filed a 6-K disclosing that on September 22, 2026, Nasdaq granted an additional 180-day period, until March 22, 2027, to regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company had been below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days since the March 25, 2026 notice and failed the initial September 21, 2026 deadline, but satisfies market value and other Capital Market criteria. It may effect a reverse share split approved by shareholders on September 16, 2026.
